name: Komine Ryouji
source:
Zodiac: Virgo

Komine is touring the world, sampling dishes and improving his skills as a chef. But is the mansion just another stop on the road?

A cheerful, good looking, young man with a Kansai accent. He gets very close to everyone he meets. His skills at cooking are second to none.
